items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: So he asked me if I wanted a job, and I said, 'Sure.' So I worked at the Savoy on numerous occasions.

ctx.x: Yeah. You can hear that on the record, too.
Yeah, he stopped and taken a breath, and they'd give him hell about that. Teddy Hill gave him hell. Boy, Teddy was on him everything he did.
Well, Teddy Hill came into the band, then, fairly early.
